content: Older adults often encounter significant social challenges that can negatively impact their overall quality of life and increase their risk of becoming dependent on others for daily activities. Implementing system-level screening mechanisms for social determinants of health (SDOH) can play a critical role in identifying structural barriers and communication gaps within the healthcare system that affect this population. By addressing these gaps, healthcare providers can create a more effective and supportive care environment tailored to the unique needs of older adults.
